milestones.label: Nominating bodies send their chosen candidates to the CSC
milestones.source_text: The Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (official) says nominating organisations must put their candidates forward to it by December 2026; each nominator sets its own earlier closing date.

milestones.label: Outcome of the 2027/28 call
milestones.source_text: The Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (official) says applicants can expect to hear the outcome by July 2027.
